topics.definition: Model evaluation measures how well a machine learning model performs on unseen data.
Accuracy is the ratio of correct predictions to total predictions.
tips: Can be misleading for imbalanced datasets.

topics.definition: Precision measures the proportion of positive predictions that are correct.
tips: Important when false positives are costly.

topics.definition: Recall measures the proportion of actual positives correctly identified.
tips: Important when false negatives are costly.

topics.definition: F1-Score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall.
ROC compares true positive and false positive rates, while AUC summarizes performance.
tips: Higher AUC generally indicates better performance.

topics.definition: Cross validation evaluates models using multiple train-test splits.
Use multiple metrics, validate with unseen data and compare models fairly.
